title: Prepare a zero-additional-AWS-cost internal CA for private Vault TLS
classification_reason: creates a Vault TLS issuance boundary
extends the private artifact supply chain
expected_outcome: The repository contains reviewed, private-ECR-pinned cert-manager delivery inputs and Vault-scoped declarative issuers, certificates, and ingress policy that can create vault/vault-tls without committing, reading, or manually creating key material.
constraints: Use only a cluster-local, Vault-namespace CA; do not create or use AWS Private CA.
Keep the EKS API private and require private ECR artifact delivery; no public listener, NAT, or public egress fallback.
All cert-manager runtime images and the Helm chart must be digest/checksum pinned and mirrored before live installation.
Do not commit, create manually, read, modify, log, or record any Kubernetes Secret data, CA private key, Vault token, kubeconfig, recovery material, or unseal material.
Do not deploy/apply resources, mirror/publish artifacts, initialize Vault, or alter live cloud/Kubernetes state in this task.

external_actions: read official public cert-manager release and signature metadata

acceptance_checks: official version, signature, image and chart pins are identified
delegations.escalation_trigger: metadata would require credentials or secret inspection

acceptance_checks: Helm render uses only private digest-pinned images
delegations.escalation_trigger: a change would apply a resource, mirror an artifact, or expose Secret data

acceptance_checks: task-level live plan approved before any execution
delegations.escalation_trigger: live authority or a security exception is required
